en.title: Contact Types
en.summary: The channels a patient can be reached on besides their main phone — Telegram, WhatsApp, email.

sections.heading: Kind
sections.body: What the value looks like: a username or handle, a phone number, an email address or a full web address. It decides how the value is checked when someone types it on the chart.

sections.heading: Link prefix
sections.body: The start of a web address for the channel, such as https://t.me/ for Telegram, kept with the channel so a value can be turned into a link. Leave it empty when there is none.

sections.heading: Retiring an entry
sections.body: Set it Inactive. It leaves the pickers, and every record that already uses it keeps showing it. Delete is for mistakes only, and only a super admin can do it.

am.title: የመገናኛ ዓይነቶች
am.summary: ከዋናው ስልክ በተጨማሪ ታካሚ የሚገኝባቸው መንገዶች — ቴሌግራም፣ ዋትስአፕ፣ ኢሜይል።

sections.heading: ዓይነት
sections.body: እሴቱ ምን እንደሚመስል፦ የተጠቃሚ ስም፣ ስልክ ቁጥር፣ የኢሜይል አድራሻ ወይም ሙሉ የድር አድራሻ። በቻርቱ ላይ ሲጻፍ እሴቱ እንዴት እንደሚረጋገጥ ይወስናል።

sections.heading: የሊንክ መነሻ
sections.body: የመንገዱ የድር አድራሻ መጀመሪያ፣ ለምሳሌ ለቴሌግራም https://t.me/። ከሌለ ባዶ ይተዉት።

sections.heading: መዝገብን ከአገልግሎት ማስወጣት
sections.body: "Inactive" ያድርጉት። ከምርጫ ዝርዝሮቹ ይወጣል፤ ቀድሞ የተጠቀሙበት መዝገቦች ሁሉ ግን ማሳየታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ። መሰረዝ ለስህተት ብቻ ነው፤ ሊሰርዝ የሚችለውም ሱፐር አድሚን ብቻ ነው።
